   100→def _render_cluster_item(item: dict) -> None:
   101→    """Render an auto-cluster task card."""
   102→    member_count = int(item.get("member_count", 0))
   103→    action_type = item.get("action_type", "manual_fix")
   104→    cluster_name = item.get("id", "")
   105→    if cluster_name == "auto/initial-review":
   106→        type_label = "Initial subjective review"
   107→    elif cluster_name == "auto/stale-review":
   108→        type_label = "Stale subjective review"
   109→    else:
   110→        type_label = _ACTION_TYPE_LABELS.get(action_type, "Grouped task")
   111→    print(colorize(f"  ({type_label}, {member_count} findings)", "bold"))
   112→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   113→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   114→
   115→    # Show breakdown by file (compact) + representative members
   116→    members = item.get("members", [])
   117→    if members:
   118→        # File distribution
   119→        from collections import Counter
   120→        file_counts = Counter(m.get("file", "?") for m in members)
   121→        if len(file_counts) <= 5:
   122→            print(colorize("\n  Files:", "dim"))
   123→            for f, c in file_counts.most_common():
   124→                print(f"    {f} ({c})")
   125→        else:
   126→            print(colorize(f"\n  Spread across {len(file_counts)} files:", "dim"))
   127→            for f, c in file_counts.most_common(3):
   128→                print(f"    {f} ({c})")
   129→            remaining = len(file_counts) - 3
   130→            print(colorize(f"    ... and {remaining} more files", "dim"))
   131→
   132→        # Sample IDs
   133→        print(colorize("\n  Sample:", "dim"))
   134→        for m in members[:3]:
   135→            print(f"    - {m.get('id', '')}")
   136→        if len(members) > 3:
   137→            print(colorize(f"    ... and {len(members) - 3} more", "dim"))
   138→
   139→    # Action
   140→    cluster_name = item.get("id", "")
   141→    primary_command = item.get("primary_command")
   142→    if primary_command:
   143→        print(colorize(f"\n  Action: {primary_command}", "cyan"))
   144→
   145→    # Resolution hints
   146→    print(colorize(f'\n  Resolve all:   desloppify plan done "{cluster_name}" '
   147→                   f'--note "<what>" --attest "{ATTEST_EXAMPLE}"', "dim"))
   148→    print(colorize(f"  Drill in:      desloppify next --cluster {cluster_name} --count 10",
   149→                   "dim"))
   150→    print(colorize(f"  Skip cluster:  desloppify plan skip {cluster_name}", "dim"))
   151→

   153→def _render_item(
   154→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, findings_scoped: dict, explain: bool,
   155→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   156→) -> None:
   157→    # Delegate to cluster renderer for cluster meta-items
   158→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
   159→        _render_cluster_item(item)
   160→        return
   161→
   162→    tier = int(item.get("effective_tier", item.get("tier", 3)))
   163→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   164→    print(colorize(f"  (Tier {tier}, {confidence} confidence)", "bold"))
   165→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   166→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   167→
   168→    # Effort/type label
   169→    if item.get("detector") == "review":
   170→        print(colorize("  Type: Design review (requires judgment)", "dim"))
   171→    elif is_auto_fix_command(item.get("primary_command")):
   172→        print(colorize("  Type: Auto-fixable", "dim"))
   173→
   174→    kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   175→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":
   176→        detail = item.get("detail", {})
   177→        subjective_score = float(
   178→            detail.get("strict_score", item.get("subjective_score", 100.0))
   179→        )
   180→        print(f"  Dimension: {detail.get('dimension_name', 'unknown')}")
   181→        print(f"  Score: {subjective_score:.1f}% (always queued as T4)")
   182→        print(
   183→            colorize(
   184→                f"  Action: {item.get('primary_command', 'desloppify review --prepare')}",
   185→                "cyan",
   186→            )
   187→        )
   188→        print(colorize(
   189→            "  Note: re-review scores what it finds — scores can go down if issues are discovered.",
   190→            "dim",
   191→        ))
   192→        if explain:
   193→            reason = item.get("explain", {}).get(
   194→                "policy",
   195→                "subjective items are fixed at T4 and do not outrank mechanical T1/T2/T3.",
   196→            )
   197→            print(colorize(f"  explain: {reason}", "dim"))
   198→        return
   199→
   200→    # Plan overrides: description, cluster, note
   201→    if item.get("plan_description"):
   202→        print(colorize(f"  → {item['plan_description']}", "cyan"))
   203→    plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
   204→    if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict):
   205→        cluster_name = plan_cluster.get("name", "")
   206→        cluster_desc = plan_cluster.get("description") or ""
   207→        total = plan_cluster.get("total_items", 0)
   208→        desc_str = f' — "{cluster_desc}"' if cluster_desc else ""
   209→        print(colorize(f"  Cluster: {cluster_name}{desc_str} ({total} items)", "dim"))
   210→    if item.get("plan_note"):
   211→        print(colorize(f"  Note: {item['plan_note']}", "dim"))
   212→
   213→    print(f"  File: {item.get('file', '')}")
   214→    print(colorize(f"  ID:   {item.get('id', '')}", "dim"))
   215→
   216→    detail = item.get("detail", {})
   217→    if detail.get("lines"):
   218→        print(f"  Lines: {', '.join(str(line_no) for line_no in detail['lines'][:8])}")
   219→    if detail.get("category"):
   220→        print(f"  Category: {detail['category']}")
   221→    if detail.get("importers") is not None:
   222→        print(f"  Active importers: {detail['importers']}")
   223→    if detail.get("suggestion"):
   224→        print(colorize(f"\n  Suggestion: {detail['suggestion']}", "dim"))
   225→
   226→    target_line = detail.get("line") or (detail.get("lines", [None]) or [None])[0]
   227→    if target_line and item.get("file") not in (".", ""):
   228→        snippet = read_code_snippet(item["file"], target_line)
   229→        if snippet:
   230→            print(colorize("\n  Code:", "dim"))
   231→            print(snippet)
   232→
   233→    if dim_scores:
   234→        detector = item.get("detector", "")
   235→        dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   236→        if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   237→            dimension_score = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   238→            strict_val = dimension_score.get("strict", dimension_score["score"])
   239→            print(
   240→                colorize(
   241→                    f"\n  Dimension: {dimension.name} — {dimension_score['score']:.1f}% "
   242→                    f"(strict: {strict_val:.1f}%) "
   243→                    f"({dimension_score['issues']} of {dimension_score['checks']:,} checks failing)",
   244→                    "dim",
   245→                )
   246→            )
   247→
   248→    # Score impact estimate
   249→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   250→    if potentials and detector and dim_scores:
   251→        try:
   252→            from desloppify.scoring import compute_score_impact
   253→            impact = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=1)
   254→            if impact > 0:
   255→                print(colorize(f"  Impact: fixing this is worth ~+{impact:.1f} pts on overall score", "cyan"))
   256→            else:
   257→                # Single-item impact rounds to 0 — try bulk impact for all issues in detector
   258→                dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   259→                if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   260→                    issues = dim_scores[dimension.name].get("issues", 0)
   261→                    if issues > 1:
   262→                        bulk = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=issues)
   263→                        if bulk > 0:
   264→                            print(colorize(
   265→                                f"  Impact: fixing all {issues} {detector} issues → ~+{bulk:.1f} pts",
   266→                                "cyan",
   267→                            ))
   268→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   269→            _ = exc
   270→    elif detector == "review" and dim_scores:
   271→        # Review findings: show dimension drag from breakdown
   272→        try:
   273→            from desloppify.scoring import compute_health_breakdown
   274→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   275→            if dim_key:
   276→                breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   277→                for entry in breakdown.get("entries", []):
   278→                    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   279→                        continue
   280→                    entry_key = str(entry.get("name", "")).lower().replace(" ", "_")
   281→                    if entry_key == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   282→                        drag = float(entry.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   283→                        if drag > 0.01:
   284→                            print(colorize(
   285→                                f"  Dimension drag: {entry['name']} costs -{drag:.2f} pts on overall score",
   286→                                "cyan",
   287→                            ))
   288→                        break
   289→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   290→            _ = exc
   291→
   292→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   293→    auto_fix_command = item.get("primary_command")
   294→    if is_auto_fix_command(auto_fix_command):
   295→        similar_count = sum(
   296→            1
   297→            for finding in findings_scoped.values()
   298→            if finding.get("detector") == detector_name and finding["status"] == "open"
   299→        )
   300→        if similar_count > 1:
   301→            print(
   302→                colorize(
   303→                    f"\n  Auto-fixable: {similar_count} similar findings. "
   304→                    f"Run `{auto_fix_command}` to fix all at once.",
   305→                    "cyan",
   306→                )
   307→            )
   308→    if explain:
   309→        explanation = item.get("explain", {})
   310→        count_weight = explanation.get("count", int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0))
   311→        base = (
   312→            f"ranked by tier={tier}, confidence={confidence}, "
   313→            f"count={count_weight}, id={item.get('id', '')}"
   314→        )
   315→
   316→        # Add dimension context for mechanical detectors
   317→        if dim_scores and detector:
   318→            dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   319→            if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   320→                ds = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   321→                base += (
   322→                    f". Dimension: {dimension.name} at {ds['score']:.1f}% "
   323→                    f"({ds['issues']} open issues)"
   324→                )
   325→
   326→        # For review findings, show subjective dimension context
   327→        if item.get("detector") == "review" and dim_scores:
   328→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   329→            if dim_key:
   330→                for ds_name, ds_data in dim_scores.items():
   331→                    if ds_name.lower().replace(" ", "_") == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   332→                        score_val = ds_data.get("score", "?")
   333→                        score_str = f"{score_val:.1f}" if isinstance(score_val, (int, float)) else str(score_val)
   334→                        base += f". Subjective dimension: {ds_name} at {score_str}%"
   335→                        break
   336→
   337→        policy = explanation.get("policy")
   338→        if policy:
   339→            base = f"{base}. {policy}"
   340→        print(colorize(f"  explain: {base}", "dim"))
   341→

   343→def render_queue_header(queue: dict, explain: bool) -> None:
   344→    _render_tier_navigator(queue)
   345→    if not queue.get("fallback_reason"):

   356→def show_empty_queue(
   357→    queue: dict,
   358→    tier: int | None,
   359→    strict: float | None,
   360→    *,
   361→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   362→    target_strict: float | None = None,
   363→) -> bool:
   364→    if queue.get("items"):
   365→        return False
   366→    # Show before/after comparison when plan_start_strict is available
   367→    if plan_start_strict is not None and strict is not None:
   368→        delta = round(strict - plan_start_strict, 1)
   369→        delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if abs(delta) >= 0.05 else ""
   370→        print(colorize("\n  Queue cleared!", "green"))
   371→        print(colorize(
   372→            f"  Plan-start: strict {plan_start_strict:.1f} → Current: strict {strict:.1f}{delta_str}",
   373→            "cyan",
   374→        ))
   375→        print(colorize(
   376→            "  Run `desloppify scan` to finalize your updated score.",
   377→            "dim",
   378→        ))
   379→    else:
   380→        suffix = f" Strict score: {strict:.1f}/100" if strict is not None else ""
   381→        print(colorize(f"\n  Nothing to do!{suffix}", "green"))
   382→    if tier is not None:
   383→        print(colorize(f"  Requested tier: T{tier}", "dim"))
   384→        available = queue.get("available_tiers", [])
   385→        if available:
   386→            commands = " | ".join(
   387→                f"desloppify next --tier {tier_num}" for tier_num in available
   388→            )
   389→            print(colorize(f"  Try: {commands}", "dim"))
   390→    return True

   393→def render_terminal_items(
   394→    items: list[dict],
   395→    dim_scores: dict,
   396→    findings_scoped: dict,
   397→    *,
   398→    group: str,
   399→    explain: bool,
   400→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   401→    plan: dict | None = None,
   402→) -> None:
   403→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster
   404→    if plan and plan.get("active_cluster"):
   405→        cluster_name = plan["active_cluster"]
   406→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   407→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   408→        total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   409→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   410→
   411→    if group != "item":
   412→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   413→        return
   414→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   415→        if idx > 0:
   416→            print()
   417→        queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   418→        if queue_pos and len(items) > 1:
   419→            label = f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   420→        elif len(items) > 1:
   421→            label = f"  [{idx + 1}/{len(items)}]"
   422→        else:
   423→            pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   424→            label = f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   425→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   426→        _render_item(item, dim_scores, findings_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials)
   427→

   429→def render_single_item_resolution_hint(items: list[dict]) -> None:

   431→        return

   436→    item = items[0]
   437→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   438→    if detector_name == "subjective_review":
   439→        print(colorize("\n  Review with:", "dim"))
   440→        primary = item.get(
   441→            "primary_command", "desloppify show subjective"
   442→        )
   443→        print(f"    {primary}")
   444→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   445→            print("    desloppify review --prepare")
   446→        return
   447→
   448→    primary = item.get("primary_command", "")
   449→    if is_auto_fix_command(primary):
   450→        print(colorize("\n  Fix with:", "dim"))
   451→        print(f"    {primary}")
   452→        print(colorize("  Or resolve individually:", "dim"))
   453→    else:
   454→        print(colorize("\n  Resolve with:", "dim"))

   456→    print(

   466→def render_followup_nudges(
   467→    state: dict,
   468→    dim_scores: dict,
   469→    findings_scoped: dict,
   470→    *,
   471→    strict_score: float | None,
   472→    target_strict_score: float,
   473→    queue_total: int = 0,
   474→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   475→) -> None:
   476→    subjective_threshold = target_strict_score
   477→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective(state, dim_scores)
   478→    followup = build_subjective_followup(
   479→        state,
   480→        subjective_entries,
   481→        threshold=subjective_threshold,
   482→        max_quality_items=3,
   483→        max_integrity_items=5,
   484→    )
   485→    unassessed_subjective = unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores)
   486→    # Show frozen plan-start score + queue remaining when in an active cycle
   487→    if queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None:
   488→        print(
   489→            colorize(
   490→                f"\n  Plan-start score: strict {plan_start_strict:.1f}/100",
   491→                "cyan",
   492→            )
   493→        )
   494→        print(
   495→            colorize(
   496→                f"  Queue: {queue_total} item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}"
   497→                " remaining — complete the queue, then scan to see your updated score.",
   498→                "dim",
   499→            )
   500→        )
   501→    elif strict_score is not None:
   502→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   503→        if gap > 0:
   504→            print(
   505→                colorize(
   506→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 → target {target_strict_score:.1f} (+{gap:.1f} needed)",
   507→                    "cyan",
   508→                )
   509→            )
   510→        else:
   511→            print(
   512→                colorize(
   513→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 meets target {target_strict_score:.1f}",
   514→                    "green",
   515→                )
   516→            )
   517→    # Integrity penalty/warn lines preserved (anti-gaming safeguard, must remain visible).
   518→    for style, message in followup.integrity_lines:
   519→        print(colorize(f"\n  {message}", style))
   520→
   521→    # Collapsed subjective summary.
   522→    coverage_open, _coverage_reasons, _holistic_reasons = subjective_coverage_breakdown(
   523→        findings_scoped
   524→    )
   525→    parts: list[str] = []
   526→    low_dims = len(followup.low_assessed)
   527→    unassessed_count = len(unassessed_subjective)
   528→    stale_count = sum(1 for e in subjective_entries if e.get("stale"))
   529→    open_review = [
   530→        f for f in findings_scoped.values()
   531→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") == "review"
   532→    ]
   533→    if low_dims:
   534→        parts.append(f"{low_dims} dimension{'s' if low_dims != 1 else ''} below target")
   535→    if stale_count:
   536→        parts.append(f"{stale_count} stale")
   537→    if unassessed_count:
   538→        parts.append(f"{unassessed_count} unassessed")
   539→    if len(open_review):
   540→        parts.append(f"{len(open_review)} review finding{'s' if len(open_review) != 1 else ''} open")
   541→    if coverage_open > 0:
   542→        parts.append(f"{coverage_open} file{'s' if coverage_open != 1 else ''} need review")
   543→
   544→    if parts:
   545→        print(colorize(f"\n  Subjective: {', '.join(parts)}.", "cyan"))
   546→        print(colorize("  Run `desloppify show subjective` for details.", "dim"))

    11→def _print_resolve_summary(*, status: str, all_resolved: list[str]) -> None:
    12→    verb = "Reopened" if status == "open" else "Resolved"
    13→    print(colorize(f"\n{verb} {len(all_resolved)} finding(s) as {status}:", "green"))
    14→    for fid in all_resolved[:20]:
    15→        print(f"  {fid}")
    16→    if len(all_resolved) > 20:
    17→        print(f"  ... and {len(all_resolved) - 20} more")
    18→
    19→
    20→def _print_wontfix_batch_warning(
    21→    state: dict,
    22→    *,
    23→    status: str,
    24→    resolved_count: int,
    25→) -> None:
    26→    if status != "wontfix" or resolved_count <= 10:
    27→        return
    28→    wontfix_count = sum(
    29→        1 for finding in state["findings"].values() if finding["status"] == "wontfix"
    30→    )
    31→    actionable = sum(
    32→        1
    33→        for finding in state["findings"].values()
    34→        if finding["status"]
    35→        in ("open", "wontfix", "fixed", "auto_resolved", "false_positive")
    36→    )
    37→    wontfix_pct = round(wontfix_count / actionable * 100) if actionable else 0
    38→    print(
    39→        colorize(
    40→            f"\n  ⚠ Wontfix debt is now {wontfix_count} findings ({wontfix_pct}% of actionable).",
    41→            "yellow",
    42→        )
    43→    )
    44→    print(
    45→        colorize(

    47→            "dim",
    48→        )
    49→    )
    50→
    51→
    52→def _delta_suffix(delta: float) -> str:
    53→    if abs(delta) < 0.05:
    54→        return ""
    55→    return f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})"
    56→
    57→
    58→def _print_score_movement(
    59→    *,

    61→    prev_overall: float | None,
    62→    prev_objective: float | None,
    63→    prev_strict: float | None,

    72→        or new.objective is None
    73→        or new.strict is None
    74→        or new.verified is None
    75→    ):
    76→        print(colorize("\n  Scores unavailable — run `desloppify scan`.", "yellow"))
    77→        return
    78→
    79→    overall_delta = new.overall - (prev_overall or 0)
    80→    objective_delta = new.objective - (prev_objective or 0)
    81→    strict_delta = new.strict - (prev_strict or 0)
    82→    verified_delta = new.verified - (prev_verified or 0)
    83→    print(

    85→        + colorize(

    90→        + colorize(

   130→def _print_subjective_reset_hint(

   153→        if dim and dim in (state.get("subjective_assessments") or {})
   154→    )
   155→    if not stale_dims:

   157→
   158→    shown = ", ".join(stale_dims[:3])
   159→    if len(stale_dims) > 3:
   160→        shown = f"{shown}, +{len(stale_dims) - 3} more"
   161→    print(
   162→        colorize(

   167→    print(
   168→        colorize(
   169→            "  Next subjective step: "
   170→            + f"`desloppify review --prepare --dimensions {','.join(stale_dims)}`",
   171→            "dim",

   173→    )

   176→def _print_next_command(state: dict) -> str:

   192→        next_command = "desloppify next"
   193→    print(colorize(f"  Next command: `{next_command}`", "dim"))

    38→) -> Callable[[str, int], float]:
    39→    """Build an impact estimator closure keyed by detector and count."""
    40→    merged_potentials = merge_potentials(state.get("potentials", {}))
    41→    if not merged_potentials or not dimension_scores:
    42→        return lambda _detector, _count: 0.0
    43→
    44→    scoring_view = {
    45→        name: {
    46→            "score": values["score"],
    47→            "tier": values.get("tier", 3),
    48→            "detectors": values.get("detectors", {}),
    49→        }
    50→        for name, values in dimension_scores.items()
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    def _impact(detector: str, count: int) -> float:
    54→        return compute_score_impact(
    55→            scoring_view, merged_potentials, detector, count
    56→        )
    57→
    58→    return _impact

    60→
    61→def _dimension_name(detector: str) -> str:
    62→    """Resolve user-facing dimension name for a detector."""
    63→    dimension = get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
    64→    return dimension.name if dimension else "Unknown"
    65→
    66→
    67→def _fixer_has_applicable_findings(
    68→    state: StateModel, detector: str, fixer_name: str
    69→) -> bool:
    70→    """For the smells detector, verify the fixer has matching open findings.
    71→
    72→    The smells detector aggregates many smell types but each fixer only handles
    73→    one sub-type (e.g. ``dead-useeffect`` only fixes ``dead_useeffect`` smells).
    74→    Without this check, a React-specific fixer can be suggested to projects that
    75→    have no React code at all, producing a confusing "Found 0 candidates" result.
    76→
    77→    For all other detectors the fixer is considered universally applicable.
    78→    """
    79→    if detector != "smells":
    80→        return True
    81→    smell_id = fixer_name.replace("-", "_")
    82→    return any(
    83→        f.get("status") == "open"
    84→        and not f.get("suppressed")
    85→        and f.get("detector") == "smells"
    86→        and f.get("detail", {}).get("smell_id") == smell_id
    87→        for f in state.get("findings", {}).values()
    88→    )
    89→

    91→def _append_auto_fix_actions(
    92→    actions: list[ActionItem],

    94→    supported: set[str] | None,
    95→    impact_for: Callable[[str, int], float],
    96→    state: StateModel,
    97→) -> None:
    98→    """Append auto-fix/manual-fix actions for detectors with auto fixers."""
    99→    for detector, tool_info in DETECTOR_TOOLS.items():
   100→        if tool_info["action_type"] != "auto_fix":
   101→            continue
   102→        count = by_detector.get(detector, 0)
   103→        if count == 0:
   104→            continue
   105→
   106→        impact = round(impact_for(detector, count), 1)
   107→        available_fixers = [
   108→            fixer
   109→            for fixer in tool_info["fixers"]
   110→            if (supported is None or fixer in supported)
   111→            and _fixer_has_applicable_findings(state, detector, fixer)
   112→        ]
   113→        if not available_fixers:
   114→            actions.append(
   115→                {
   116→                    "type": "manual_fix",
   117→                    "detector": detector,
   118→                    "count": count,
   119→                    "description": (
   120→                        f"{count} {detector} findings — inspect with "
   121→                        f"`desloppify next` and fix manually"
   122→                    ),
   123→                    "command": f"desloppify show {detector} --status open",
   124→                    "impact": impact,
   125→                    "dimension": _dimension_name(detector),
   126→                }
   127→            )
   128→            continue
   129→
   130→        fixer = available_fixers[0]
   131→        actions.append(

   106→    resolve_all_patterns_fn,

   109→    before = state_mod.get_strict_score(state)
   110→    if before is None:
   111→        return 0.0
   112→
   113→    preview_state = copy.deepcopy(state)
   114→    resolve_all_patterns_fn(preview_state, args, attestation=attestation)
   115→    after = state_mod.get_strict_score(preview_state)
   116→    if after is None:
   117→        return 0.0
   118→    return max(0.0, before - after)
   119→
   120→
   121→def _enforce_batch_wontfix_confirmation(
   122→    state: dict,
   123→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   124→    *,
   125→    attestation: str | None,
   126→    resolve_all_patterns_fn,
   127→) -> None:

   129→        return
   130→
   131→    preview_count = _preview_resolve_count(state, args.patterns)
   132→    if preview_count <= 10:

   134→    if getattr(args, "confirm_batch_wontfix", False):

   136→
   137→    strict_delta = _estimate_wontfix_strict_delta(

   141→        resolve_all_patterns_fn=resolve_all_patterns_fn,
   142→    )
   143→    _emit_warning(f"Large wontfix batch detected ({preview_count} findings).")
   144→    if strict_delta > 0:

   146→    _emit_warning(

   148→    )

> DEVELOPER

Explore the desloppify codebase to understand two issues:

1. **Score regression from structural fixes**: When an agent decomposes a large file into smaller ones, the rescan finds MORE findings (new duplication, new structural surface area). Look at:
   - How structural findings are generated (the structural detector)
   - How the score is computed after scan
   - Whether there's any mechanism to suppress expected churn from file splits
   - The `scan_reporting_summary.py` or similar files that show scan results

2. **Subjective score gap guidance**: The agent noticed that code changes barely move the strict score because subjective dimensions dominate. Look at:
   - How `render_followup_nudges` in render.py shows the gap
   - Whether the tool clearly tells agents "you need a re-review, not more code fixes" when subjective scores are the bottleneck
   - The score recipe / weighted drag calculations

Thoroughness: medium.

    26→def detail_dict(item: dict) -> dict:
    27→    """Return finding detail as a dict; tolerate legacy/non-dict payloads."""
    28→    detail = item.get("detail")
    29→    return detail if isinstance(detail, dict) else {}

    32→def status_matches(item_status: str, status_filter: str) -> bool:

    36→def is_subjective_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    37→    detector = item.get("detector")

    40→    if detector == "holistic_review":
    41→        return True
    42→    return False
    43→

    49→def review_finding_weight(item: dict) -> float:
    50→    """Return review issue weight aligned with issues list ordering."""
    51→    confidence = str(item.get("confidence", "low")).lower()
    52→    weight_by_confidence = {
    53→        "high": 1.0,
    54→        "medium": 0.7,
    55→        "low": 0.3,
    56→    }
    57→    weight = weight_by_confidence.get(confidence, 0.3)
    58→    if detail_dict(item).get("holistic"):
    59→        weight *= 10.0
    60→    return float(weight)
    61→
    62→
    63→def scope_matches(item: dict, scope: str | None) -> bool:
    64→    """Apply show-style pattern matching against a queue item."""
    65→    if not scope:

    67→
    68→    item_id = item.get("id", "")
    69→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    70→    filepath = item.get("file", "")
    71→    summary = item.get("summary", "")
    72→    dimension = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    73→    kind = item.get("kind", "")
    74→
    75→    if "*" in scope:
    76→        return any(
    77→            fnmatch(candidate, scope)
    78→            for candidate in (item_id, filepath, detector, dimension, summary)
    79→        )
    80→
    81→    if "::" in scope:
    82→        return item_id.startswith(scope)
    83→
    84→    lowered = scope.lower()
    85→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":

    87→            lowered in item_id.lower()
    88→            or lowered in dimension.lower()
    89→            or lowered in summary.lower()
    90→        )
    91→
    92→    # Hash suffix: 8+ hex chars matches the tail segment of a finding ID.
    93→    if len(lowered) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+", lowered):
    94→        return item_id.lower().endswith("::" + lowered)
    95→

   120→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   121→    canonical = _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(cleaned)
   122→    return {
   123→        cleaned.lower(),
   124→        cleaned.replace(" ", "_").lower(),
   125→        slugify(cleaned),
   126→        canonical.lower(),
   127→        slugify(canonical),

   133→    lang = str(item.get("lang", "") or "").strip()

1→"""Structural signal helpers shared across language phase implementations."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from pathlib import Path
     6→
     7→from desloppify.core._internal.text_utils import PROJECT_ROOT
     8→from desloppify.core.discovery_api import resolve_path
     9→from desloppify.state import Finding, make_finding
    10→
    11→
    12→def add_structural_signal(structural: dict, file: str, signal: str, detail: dict):
    13→    """Add a complexity signal to the per-file structural dict.
    14→
    15→    Accumulates signals per file so they can be merged into tiered findings.
    16→    """
    17→    f = resolve_path(file)
    18→    structural.setdefault(f, {"signals": [], "detail": {}})
    19→    structural[f]["signals"].append(signal)
    20→    structural[f]["detail"].update(detail)
    21→
    22→
    23→def merge_structural_signals(
    24→    structural: dict,
    25→    stderr_fn,
    26→    *,
    27→    complexity_only_min: int = 35,
    28→) -> list[Finding]:
    29→    """Convert per-file structural signals into tiered findings.
    30→
    31→    3+ signals -> T4/high (needs decomposition).
    32→    1-2 signals -> T3/medium.
    33→    Complexity-only files (no large/god signals) need score >= complexity_only_min
    34→    to be flagged — lower complexity in small files is normal, not decomposition-worthy.
    35→    """
    36→    results = []
    37→    suppressed = 0
    38→    for filepath, data in structural.items():
    39→        if "loc" not in data["detail"]:
    40→            try:
    41→                p = (
    42→                    Path(filepath) if Path(filepath).is_absolute() else PROJECT_ROOT / filepath
    43→                )
    44→                data["detail"]["loc"] = len(p.read_text().splitlines())
    45→            except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
    46→                data["detail"]["loc"] = 0
    47→
    48→        # Suppress complexity-only findings below the elevated threshold.
    49→        signals = data["signals"]
    50→        is_complexity_only = all(s.startswith("complexity") for s in signals)
    51→        if is_complexity_only:
    52→            score = data["detail"].get("complexity_score", 0)
    53→            if score < complexity_only_min:
    54→                suppressed += 1
    55→                continue
    56→
    57→        signal_count = len(signals)
    58→        tier = 4 if signal_count >= 3 else 3
    59→        confidence = "high" if signal_count >= 3 else "medium"
    60→        summary = "Needs decomposition: " + " / ".join(signals)
    61→        results.append(
    62→            make_finding(
    63→                "structural",
    64→                filepath,
    65→                "",
    66→                tier=tier,
    67→                confidence=confidence,
    68→                summary=summary,
    69→                detail=data["detail"],
    70→            )
    71→        )
    72→    if suppressed:
    73→        stderr_fn(
    74→            "         "
    75→            f"{suppressed} complexity-only files below threshold (< {complexity_only_min})"
    76→        )
    77→    stderr_fn(f"         -> {len(results)} structural findings")
    78→    return results
    79→
    80→
    81→__all__ = ["add_structural_signal", "merge_structural_signals"]
    82→

1→"""Score and diff summary output for scan command."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import logging
     6→
     7→from desloppify import state as state_mod
     8→from desloppify.app.commands.scan.scan_helpers import format_delta
     9→from desloppify.app.commands.status_parts.strict_target import (
    10→    format_strict_target_progress,
    11→)
    12→from desloppify.app.commands.scan.scan_reporting_llm import _is_agent_environment
    13→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize

    15→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    16→
    17→
    18→def _consecutive_subjective_integrity_status(state: dict, status: str) -> int:
    19→    """Return consecutive trailing scans with the given subjective-integrity status."""
    20→    history = state.get("scan_history", [])
    21→    if not isinstance(history, list):
    22→        return 0
    23→
    24→    streak = 0
    25→    for entry in reversed(history):
    26→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
    27→            break
    28→        integrity = entry.get("subjective_integrity")
    29→        if not isinstance(integrity, dict):
    30→            break
    31→        if integrity.get("status") != status:
    32→            break
    33→        streak += 1
    34→    return streak
    35→
    36→
    37→def _show_score_reveal(
    38→    state: dict,
    39→    new: state_mod.ScoreSnapshot,
    40→    *,
    41→    target_strict: float | None = None,
    42→) -> None:
    43→    """Show before/after score comparison when a queue cycle just completed.
    44→
    45→    This fires when the plan had ``plan_start_scores`` and the queue was empty
    46→    at scan time (i.e. the reconcile block cleared plan_start_scores).  We detect
    47→    this by checking the plan *before* the clear happened — since merge_scan_results
    48→    clears it, we peek at the ``_last_score_reveal`` stash it leaves behind.
    49→    """
    50→    # scan_workflow stashes the old plan_start_scores on state as a transient
    51→    # key when it clears them (queue empty).  Pop it here for the reveal.
    52→    plan_start = state.pop("_plan_start_scores_for_reveal", None)
    53→    if not isinstance(plan_start, dict) or not plan_start.get("strict"):
    54→        return
    55→
    56→    old_strict = float(plan_start["strict"])
    57→    new_strict = float(new.strict or 0)
    58→    delta = round(new_strict - old_strict, 1)
    59→    delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if abs(delta) >= 0.05 else ""
    60→
    61→    bar = "=" * 50
    62→    print(colorize(f"  {bar}", "cyan"))
    63→    print(colorize("  SCORE UPDATE — Queue cycle complete!", "bold"))
    64→    print(colorize(f"  Plan-start: strict {old_strict:.1f}/100", "dim"))
    65→    print(colorize(f"  Updated:    strict {new_strict:.1f}/100{delta_str}", "cyan"))
    66→    if target_strict is not None:
    67→        target_gap = round(target_strict - new_strict, 1)
    68→        if target_gap > 0:
    69→            print(colorize(f"  Target:     {target_strict:.1f} (+{target_gap:.1f} to go)", "dim"))
    70→        else:
    71→            print(colorize(f"  Target:     {target_strict:.1f} — reached!", "green"))
    72→    print(colorize(f"  {bar}", "cyan"))
    73→
    74→
    75→def show_diff_summary(diff: dict):
    76→    """Print the +new / -resolved / reopened one-liner."""
    77→    diff_parts = []
    78→    if diff["new"]:
    79→        diff_parts.append(colorize(f"+{diff['new']} new", "yellow"))
    80→    if diff["auto_resolved"]:
    81→        diff_parts.append(colorize(f"-{diff['auto_resolved']} resolved", "green"))
    82→    if diff["reopened"]:
    83→        diff_parts.append(colorize(f"↻{diff['reopened']} reopened", "red"))
    84→    if diff_parts:
    85→        print(f"  {' · '.join(diff_parts)}")
    86→    else:
    87→        print(colorize("  No changes since last scan", "dim"))
    88→    if diff.get("suspect_detectors"):
    89→        print(
    90→            colorize(
    91→                "  ⚠ Skipped auto-resolve for: "
    92→                f"{', '.join(diff['suspect_detectors'])} (returned 0 — likely transient)",
    93→                "yellow",
    94→            )
    95→        )
    96→
    97→
    98→def show_score_delta(
    99→    state: dict,
   100→    prev_overall: float | None,
   101→    prev_objective: float | None,
   102→    prev_strict: float | None,
   103→    prev_verified: float | None = None,
   104→    non_comparable_reason: str | None = None,
   105→    *,
   106→    target_strict: float | None = None,
   107→):
   108→    """Print the canonical score quartet with deltas."""
   109→    stats = state["stats"]
   110→    new = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   111→
   112→    if (
   113→        new.overall is None
   114→        or new.objective is None
   115→        or new.strict is None
   116→        or new.verified is None
   117→    ):
   118→        print(
   119→            colorize(
   120→                "  Scores unavailable — run a full scan with language detectors enabled.",
   121→                "yellow",
   122→            )
   123→        )
   124→        return
   125→
   126→    # Detect score-reveal scan: plan_start_scores existed and queue was clear
   127→    _show_score_reveal(state, new, target_strict=target_strict)
   128→
   129→    overall_delta_str, overall_color = format_delta(new.overall, prev_overall)
   130→    objective_delta_str, objective_color = format_delta(new.objective, prev_objective)
   131→    strict_delta_str, strict_color = format_delta(new.strict, prev_strict)
   132→    verified_delta_str, verified_color = format_delta(new.verified, prev_verified)
   133→    print(
   134→        "  Scores: "
   135→        + colorize(f"overall {new.overall:.1f}/100{overall_delta_str}", overall_color)
   136→        + colorize(
   137→            f"  objective {new.objective:.1f}/100{objective_delta_str}",
   138→            objective_color,
   139→        )
   140→        + colorize(f"  strict {new.strict:.1f}/100{strict_delta_str}", strict_color)
   141→        + colorize(
   142→            f"  verified {new.verified:.1f}/100{verified_delta_str}",
   143→            verified_color,
   144→        )
   145→    )
   146→    if isinstance(non_comparable_reason, str) and non_comparable_reason.strip():
   147→        print(colorize(f"  Δ non-comparable: {non_comparable_reason.strip()}", "yellow"))
   148→    # Surface wontfix debt gap prominently when significant
   149→    wontfix = stats.get("wontfix", 0)
   150→    gap = (new.overall or 0) - (new.strict or 0)
   151→    if gap >= 5 and wontfix >= 10:
   152→        print(
   153→            colorize(
   154→                f"  ⚠ {gap:.1f}-point gap between overall and strict — "
   155→                f"{wontfix} wontfix items represent hidden debt",
   156→                "yellow",
   157→            )
   158→        )
   159→
   160→    # Score legend — shown on first scan or when strict gap is significant
   161→    scan_count = state.get("scan_count", 0)
   162→    if scan_count <= 1 or gap > 10 or _is_agent_environment():
   163→        print(colorize("  Score guide:", "dim"))
   164→        print(colorize("    overall  = 40% mechanical + 60% subjective (lenient — ignores wontfix)", "dim"))
   165→        print(colorize("    objective = mechanical detectors only (no subjective review)", "dim"))
   166→        print(colorize("    strict   = like overall, but wontfix counts against you  <-- your north star", "dim"))
   167→        print(colorize("    verified = strict, but only credits scan-verified fixes", "dim"))

   274→def _update_objective_health(
   275→    state: StateModel,
   276→    findings: dict,
   277→    *,
   278→    subjective_integrity_target: float | None = None,
   279→) -> None:
   280→    """Compute canonical score trio from dimension scoring."""
   281→    pots = state.get("potentials", {})
   282→    if not pots:
   283→        return
   284→
   285→    # Deferred import to avoid circular dependency with desloppify.scoring
   286→    # (scoring -> _scoring/results/core -> _scoring/subjective/core -> review -> state -> _state/merge -> _state/scoring)
   287→    from desloppify.scoring import (
   288→        compute_health_score,
   289→        compute_score_bundle,
   290→        merge_potentials,
   291→    )
   292→
   293→    merged = merge_potentials(pots)
   294→    if not merged:
   295→        return
   296→
   297→    subjective_assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments") or None
   298→    integrity_target = (
   299→        max(0.0, min(100.0, float(subjective_integrity_target)))
   300→        if isinstance(subjective_integrity_target, int | float)
   301→        else None
   302→    )
   303→    integrity_meta = _subjective_integrity_baseline(integrity_target)
   304→    if subjective_assessments and integrity_target is not None:
   305→        subjective_assessments, integrity_meta = _apply_subjective_integrity_policy(
   306→            subjective_assessments,
   307→            target=integrity_target,
   308→        )
   309→    state["subjective_integrity"] = integrity_meta
   310→
   311→    has_active_checks = any((count or 0) > 0 for count in merged.values())
   312→    if not has_active_checks and not subjective_assessments:
   313→        state["dimension_scores"] = {}
   314→        state["overall_score"] = 100.0
   315→        state["objective_score"] = 100.0
   316→        state["strict_score"] = 100.0
   317→        state["verified_strict_score"] = 100.0
   318→        return
   319→
   320→    # Use the full scorecard dimensions for 0-score placeholders so every
   321→    # dimension the review workflow covers gets a placeholder when unreviewed.
   322→    # Explicit assessments outside this set still count
   323→    # (append_subjective_dimensions handles that).
   324→    allowed_subjective: set[str] | None = None
   325→    lang_name = _resolve_lang_from_state(state)
   326→    if lang_name:
   327→        try:
   328→            from desloppify.intelligence.review.dimensions.data import (
   329→                load_dimensions_for_lang,
   330→            )
   331→
   332→            dims, _, _ = load_dimensions_for_lang(lang_name)
   333→            if dims:
   334→                allowed_subjective = set(dims)
   335→        except (ImportError, AttributeError) as exc:
   336→            _ = exc
   337→
   338→    bundle = compute_score_bundle(
   339→        findings,
   340→        merged,
   341→        subjective_assessments=subjective_assessments,
   342→        allowed_subjective_dimensions=allowed_subjective,
   343→    )
   344→    lenient_scores = bundle.dimension_scores
   345→    strict_scores = bundle.strict_dimension_scores
   346→    verified_strict_scores = bundle.verified_strict_dimension_scores
   347→
   348→    prev_dim_scores = dict(state.get("dimension_scores", {}))
   349→
   350→    state["dimension_scores"] = {
   351→        name: dict(
   352→            score=lenient_scores[name]["score"],
   353→            strict_score=strict_scores[name]["score"],
   354→            verified_strict_score=verified_strict_scores[name]["score"],
   355→            checks=lenient_scores[name]["checks"],
   356→            issues=lenient_scores[name]["issues"],
   357→            tier=lenient_scores[name]["tier"],
   358→            detectors=lenient_scores[name].get("detectors", {}),
   359→        )
   360→        for name in lenient_scores
   361→    }
   362→    for data in state["dimension_scores"].values():
   363→        data["strict"] = data["strict_score"]
   364→
   365→    # Carry forward mechanical dimensions from a prior scan that are absent
   366→    # now (e.g. duplication when --skip-slow is used).
   367→    for dim_name, prev_data in prev_dim_scores.items():
   368→        if dim_name in state["dimension_scores"]:
   369→            continue
   370→        if not isinstance(prev_data, dict):
   371→            continue
   372→        if "subjective_assessment" in prev_data.get("detectors", {}):
   373→            continue
   374→        carried = {**prev_data, "carried_forward": True}
   375→        # Backfill for state files written before verified_strict_score existed.
   376→        carried.setdefault(
   377→            "verified_strict_score",
   378→            carried.get("strict_score", carried.get("strict", carried.get("score", 0.0))),
   379→        )
   380→        state["dimension_scores"][dim_name] = carried
   381→
   382→    _apply_scan_coverage_to_dimension_scores(
   383→        state,
   384→        dimension_scores=state["dimension_scores"],
   385→    )
   386→
   387→    state.update(_aggregate_scores(state["dimension_scores"], compute_health_score))

   390→def _recompute_stats(
   391→    state: StateModel,
   392→    scan_path: str | None = None,
   393→    *,
   394→    subjective_integrity_target: float | None = None,
   395→) -> None:
   396→    """Recompute stats and canonical health scores from findings."""
   397→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   398→    findings = path_scoped_findings(state["findings"], scan_path)
   399→    counters, tier_stats = _count_findings(findings)
   400→    state["stats"] = {
   401→        "total": sum(counters.values()),
   402→        **counters,
   403→        "by_tier": {
   404→            str(tier): tier_counts for tier, tier_counts in sorted(tier_stats.items())
   405→        },
   406→    }
   407→    _update_objective_health(
   408→        state,
   409→        findings,
   410→        subjective_integrity_target=subjective_integrity_target,
   411→    )

   414→def _empty_suppression_metrics() -> dict[str, int | float]:
   415→    return {
   416→        "last_ignored": 0,
   417→        "last_raw_findings": 0,
   418→        "last_suppressed_pct": 0.0,
   419→        "last_ignore_patterns": 0,
   420→        "recent_scans": 0,
   421→        "recent_ignored": 0,
   422→        "recent_raw_findings": 0,
   423→        "recent_suppressed_pct": 0.0,
   424→    }
   425→
   426→
   427→def suppression_metrics(state: StateModel, *, window: int = 5) -> dict[str, int | float]:
   428→    """Summarize ignore suppression from recent scan history."""
   429→    history = state.get("scan_history", [])
   430→    if not history:
   431→        return _empty_suppression_metrics()
   432→
   433→    scans_with_suppression = [
   434→        entry
   435→        for entry in history
   436→        if isinstance(entry, dict)
   437→        and (
   438→            "ignored" in entry
   439→            or "raw_findings" in entry
   440→            or "suppressed_pct" in entry
   441→            or "ignore_patterns" in entry
   442→        )
   443→    ]
   444→    if not scans_with_suppression:
   445→        return _empty_suppression_metrics()
   446→
   447→    recent = scans_with_suppression[-max(1, window) :]
   448→    last = recent[-1]
   449→
   450→    recent_ignored = sum(int(entry.get("ignored", 0) or 0) for entry in recent)
   451→    recent_raw = sum(int(entry.get("raw_findings", 0) or 0) for entry in recent)
   452→    recent_pct = round(recent_ignored / recent_raw * 100, 1) if recent_raw else 0.0
   453→
   454→    last_ignored = int(last.get("ignored", 0) or 0)
   455→    last_raw = int(last.get("raw_findings", 0) or 0)
   456→    if "suppressed_pct" in last:
   457→        last_pct = round(float(last.get("suppressed_pct") or 0.0), 1)
   458→    else:
   459→        last_pct = round(last_ignored / last_raw * 100, 1) if last_raw else 0.0
   460→
   461→    return {
   462→        "last_ignored": last_ignored,
   463→        "last_raw_findings": last_raw,
   464→        "last_suppressed_pct": last_pct,
   465→        "last_ignore_patterns": int(last.get("ignore_patterns", 0) or 0),
   466→        "recent_scans": len(recent),
   467→        "recent_ignored": recent_ignored,
   468→        "recent_raw_findings": recent_raw,
   469→        "recent_suppressed_pct": recent_pct,
   470→    }
   471→

    10→
    11→def print_agent_plan(
    12→    steps: list[str],
    13→    *,
    14→    next_command: str | None = None,
    15→    header: str = "  AGENT PLAN:",
    16→    plan: dict | None = None,
    17→) -> None:
    18→    """Print a consistent AGENT PLAN block with numbered steps.
    19→
    20→    When a living *plan* is active, renders plan focus/progress instead
    21→    of the narrative-derived steps.
    22→    """
    23→    if plan and (plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("clusters")):
    24→        _print_plan_agent_block(plan, header=header)
    25→        return
    26→    if not steps:

    28→    print(colorize(header, "yellow"))
    29→    for idx, step in enumerate(steps, 1):
    30→        print(colorize(f"  {idx}. {step}", "dim"))
    31→    if next_command:
    32→        print(colorize(f"  Next command: `{next_command}`", "dim"))

    34→
    35→def _print_plan_agent_block(plan: dict, *, header: str = "  AGENT PLAN:") -> None:
    36→    """Render the living plan as the agent plan block."""
    37→    active = plan.get("active_cluster")
    38→    ordered = len(plan.get("queue_order", []))
    39→    skipped = len(plan.get("skipped", {}))
    40→
    41→    print(colorize(header, "yellow"))
    42→    print(colorize(f"  Living plan active: {ordered} ordered, {skipped} skipped.", "dim"))
    43→    if active:
    44→        cluster = plan.get("clusters", {}).get(active, {})
    45→        remaining = len(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
    46→        print(colorize(f"  Focused on: {active} ({remaining} items remaining).", "dim"))
    47→    print(colorize("  Next command: `desloppify next`", "dim"))
    48→    print(colorize("  View plan: `desloppify plan`", "dim"))

    55→    rel_fn: Callable[[str], str] = rel,
    56→) -> None:
    57→    """Print grouped old→new replacement lines by file."""
    58→    if not groups:
    59→        return
    60→    print(colorize(title, "cyan"))
    61→    for filepath, replacements in sorted(groups.items()):
    62→        print(f"    {rel_fn(filepath)}:")
    63→        for old, new in replacements:
    64→            print(f"      {old}  →  {new}")
    65→    print()
    66→
    67→
    68→def print_ranked_actions(
    69→    actions: list[dict], *, limit: int = 3, plan: dict | None = None
    70→) -> bool:
    71→    """Print the highest-impact narrative actions and return True when shown."""
    72→    ranked = sorted(
    73→        [action for action in actions if int(action.get("count", 0)) > 0],
    74→        key=lambda action: (
    75→            -float(action.get("impact", 0.0)),
    76→            -int(action.get("count", 0)),
    77→            int(action.get("priority", 999)),
    78→        ),
    79→    )
    80→    if not ranked:
    81→        return False
    82→    has_plan = plan and (plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("clusters"))
    83→    label = "Score context:" if has_plan else "Biggest things impacting score:"
    84→    print(colorize(f"  {label}", "cyan"))
    85→    for action in ranked[:limit]:
    86→        detector = action.get("detector", "unknown")
    87→        count = int(action.get("count", 0))
    88→        cluster_count = action.get("cluster_count")
    89→        if cluster_count:
    90→            print(colorize(f"    - {detector}: {count} open in {cluster_count} cluster(s) — `desloppify next`", "dim"))
    91→        else:
    92→            command = action.get("command", "desloppify next")
    93→            print(colorize(f"    - {detector}: {count} open — `{command}`", "dim"))
    94→    return True
    95→
    96→
    97→__all__ = [
    98→    "print_agent_plan",
    99→    "print_ranked_actions",
   100→    "print_replacement_groups",
   101→]
   102→

    26→
    27→T = TypeVar("T")
    28→
    29→
    30→def register_lang(name: str) -> Callable[[T], T]:
    31→    """Decorator to register a language config class.
    32→
    33→    Validates structure, instantiates the class, validates the contract,
    34→    and stores the *instance* in the registry.
    35→    """
    36→
    37→    def decorator(cls: T) -> T:
    38→        module = inspect.getmodule(cls)
    39→        if module and hasattr(module, "__file__"):
    40→            validate_lang_structure(Path(module.__file__).parent, name)
    41→        if isinstance(cls, type) and issubclass(cls, LangConfig):
    42→            cfg = make_lang_config(name, cls)  # instantiate + validate
    43→            registry_state.register(name, cfg)  # store instance
    44→        else:
    45→            registry_state.register(name, cls)  # test doubles
    46→        return cls
    47→
    48→    return decorator
    49→
    50→
    51→def register_generic_lang(name: str, cfg: LangConfig) -> None:
    52→    """Register a pre-built language plugin instance (no package structure required)."""
    53→    validate_lang_contract(name, cfg)
    54→    registry_state.register(name, cfg)
    55→

1→"""Language-resolution helpers for command modules."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import logging
     6→from collections.abc import Callable
     7→from functools import lru_cache
     8→from pathlib import Path
     9→from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
    10→
    11→from desloppify import languages as lang_api
    12→from desloppify.core._internal.text_utils import PROJECT_ROOT
    13→
    14→if TYPE_CHECKING:
    15→    from desloppify.languages._framework.base.types import LangConfig
    16→
    17→
    18→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    19→
    20→
    21→class LangResolutionError(SystemExit):
    22→    """Raised when language resolution fails with a user-facing message.
    23→
    24→    Inherits from SystemExit so that callers which don't catch it explicitly
    25→    will still terminate with a non-zero exit code, matching the previous
    26→    sys.exit(1) behaviour.  The CLI top-level catches it to print a clean
    27→    error without a traceback.
    28→    """
    29→
    30→    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:
    31→        self.message = message
    32→        super().__init__(1)
    33→
    34→
    35→EXTRA_ROOT_MARKERS = (
    36→    "package.json",
    37→    "pyproject.toml",
    38→    "setup.py",
    39→    "setup.cfg",
    40→    "go.mod",
    41→    "Cargo.toml",
    42→)
    43→
    44→
    45→def _cache_once(fn: Callable[[], tuple[str, ...]]) -> Callable[[], tuple[str, ...]]:
    46→    """Cache a zero-arg function once while preserving cache_clear for tests."""
    47→    cached = lru_cache(maxsize=1)(fn)
    48→    return cached
    49→
    50→
    51→@_cache_once
    52→def _lang_config_markers() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    53→    """Collect project-root marker files from language plugins + fallback markers."""
    54→    markers = set(EXTRA_ROOT_MARKERS)
    55→
    56→    for lang_name in lang_api.available_langs():
    57→        try:
    58→            cfg = lang_api.get_lang(lang_name)
    59→        except (ImportError, ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as exc:
    60→            logger.debug(
    61→                "Skipping language marker collection for %s: %s", lang_name, exc
    62→            )
    63→            continue
    64→        for marker in getattr(cfg, "detect_markers", []) or []:
    65→            if not isinstance(marker, str):
    66→                continue
    67→            cleaned = marker.strip()
    68→            if cleaned:
    69→                markers.add(cleaned)
    70→    return tuple(sorted(markers))
    71→
    72→
    73→def resolve_detection_root(
    74→    args,
    75→    *,
    76→    project_root: Path = PROJECT_ROOT,
    77→    marker_provider: Callable[[], tuple[str, ...]] | None = None,
    78→) -> Path:
    79→    """Best root to auto-detect language from."""
    80→    marker_provider = marker_provider or _lang_config_markers
    81→    markers = marker_provider()
    82→
    83→    raw_path = getattr(args, "path", None)
    84→    if not raw_path:
    85→        return project_root
    86→
    87→    candidate = Path(raw_path)
    88→    if not candidate.is_absolute():
    89→        candidate = project_root / candidate
    90→    candidate = candidate.resolve()
    91→    search_root = candidate if candidate.is_dir() else candidate.parent
    92→
    93→    for root in (search_root, *search_root.parents):
    94→        if any((root / marker).exists() for marker in markers):
    95→            return root
    96→    return search_root
    97→
    98→
    99→def auto_detect_lang_name(args) -> str | None:
   100→    """Auto-detect language using the most relevant root for this command."""
   101→    root = resolve_detection_root(args)
   102→    detected = lang_api.auto_detect_lang(root)
   103→    if detected is None and root != PROJECT_ROOT:
   104→        detected = lang_api.auto_detect_lang(PROJECT_ROOT)
   105→    return detected
   106→
   107→
   108→def resolve_lang(args) -> LangConfig | None:
   109→    """Resolve language config from args, with auto-detection fallback."""
   110→    lang_name = getattr(args, "lang", None)
   111→    if lang_name is None:
   112→        lang_name = auto_detect_lang_name(args)
   113→    if lang_name is None:
   114→        return None
   115→    try:
   116→        return lang_api.get_lang(lang_name)
   117→    except ValueError as exc:
   118→        langs = lang_api.available_langs()
   119→        langs_str = ", ".join(langs) if langs else "registered language plugins"
   120→        raise LangResolutionError(
   121→            f"{exc}\n  Hint: use --lang to select manually (available: {langs_str})"
   122→        ) from exc
   123→
   124→
   125→def resolve_lang_settings(config: dict, lang: LangConfig) -> dict[str, object]:
   126→    """Resolve persisted per-language settings from config.languages.<lang>."""
   127→    if not isinstance(config, dict):
   128→        return lang.normalize_settings({})
   129→    languages = config.get("languages", {})
   130→    if not isinstance(languages, dict):
   131→        return lang.normalize_settings({})
   132→    raw = languages.get(lang.name, {})
   133→    return lang.normalize_settings(raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {})
   134→

    30→    dimension_scores: dict[str, dict]

    32→    verified_strict_dimension_scores: dict[str, dict]

    34→    objective_score: float

    39→def compute_dimension_scores_by_mode(
    40→    findings: dict,
    41→    potentials: dict[str, int],
    42→    *,
    43→    subjective_assessments: dict | None = None,
    44→    allowed_subjective_dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
    45→) -> dict[ScoreMode, dict[str, dict]]:
    46→    """Compute dimension scores for lenient/strict/verified_strict in one pass."""
    47→    results: dict[ScoreMode, dict[str, dict]] = {mode: {} for mode in SCORING_MODES}
    48→
    49→    for dim in DIMENSIONS:
    50→        totals = {
    51→            mode: {
    52→                "checks": 0,
    53→                "issues": 0,
    54→                "weighted_failures": 0.0,
    55→                "detectors": {},
    56→            }
    57→            for mode in SCORING_MODES
    58→        }
    59→
    60→        for detector in dim.detectors:
    61→            potential = potentials.get(detector, 0)
    62→            if potential <= 0:
    63→                continue
    64→
    65→            detector_stats = detector_stats_by_mode(detector, findings, potential)
    66→            for mode in SCORING_MODES:
    67→                pass_rate, issues, weighted = detector_stats[mode]
    68→                totals[mode]["checks"] += potential
    69→                totals[mode]["issues"] += issues
    70→                totals[mode]["weighted_failures"] += weighted
    71→                totals[mode]["detectors"][detector] = {
    72→                    "potential": potential,
    73→                    "pass_rate": pass_rate,
    74→                    "issues": issues,
    75→                    "weighted_failures": weighted,
    76→                }
    77→
    78→        for mode in SCORING_MODES:
    79→            total_checks = totals[mode]["checks"]
    80→            if total_checks <= 0:
    81→                continue
    82→            dim_score = (
    83→                max(
    84→                    0.0,
    85→                    (total_checks - totals[mode]["weighted_failures"]) / total_checks,
    86→                )
    87→                * 100
    88→            )
    89→            results[mode][dim.name] = {
    90→                "score": round(dim_score, 1),
    91→                "tier": dim.tier,
    92→                "checks": total_checks,
    93→                "issues": totals[mode]["issues"],
    94→                "detectors": totals[mode]["detectors"],
    95→            }
    96→
    97→    for mode in SCORING_MODES:
    98→        append_subjective_dimensions(
    99→            results[mode],
   100→            findings,
   101→            subjective_assessments,
   102→            FAILURE_STATUSES_BY_MODE[mode],
   103→            allowed_dimensions=allowed_subjective_dimensions,
   104→        )
   105→    return results
   106→
   107→
   108→def compute_dimension_scores(
   109→    findings: dict,
   110→    potentials: dict[str, int],

   114→    allowed_subjective_dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
   115→) -> dict[str, dict]:
   116→    """Compute per-dimension scores from findings and potentials."""
   117→    mode: ScoreMode = "strict" if strict else "lenient"
   118→    return compute_dimension_scores_by_mode(
   119→        findings,
   120→        potentials,

   101→def _build_dimensions() -> list[Dimension]:
   102→    """Derive dimensions from DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.
   103→
   104→    Each unique (dimension, tier) pair becomes a Dimension, with its detectors
   105→    collected automatically. Order follows first-seen in the policies dict.
   106→    """
   107→    # Collect (dimension_name -> tier) preserving first-seen order,
   108→    # and group detectors by dimension.
   109→    dim_tiers: dict[str, int] = {}
   110→    grouped: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   111→    for detector, policy in DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.items():
   112→        if policy.dimension is None or policy.tier is None:
   113→            continue
   114→        if policy.dimension not in dim_tiers:
   115→            dim_tiers[policy.dimension] = policy.tier
   116→            grouped[policy.dimension] = []
   117→        grouped[policy.dimension].append(detector)
   118→    return [
   119→        Dimension(name=name, tier=tier, detectors=grouped[name])
   120→        for name, tier in dim_tiers.items()
   121→    ]

   193→
   194→def matches_target_score(
   195→    score: object,
   196→    target: object,
   197→    *,
   198→    tolerance: float = SUBJECTIVE_TARGET_MATCH_TOLERANCE,
   199→) -> bool:
   200→    """Return True when score is within tolerance of target."""
   201→    try:
   202→        score_value = float(score)
   203→        target_value = float(target)
   204→        tolerance_value = max(0.0, float(tolerance))
   205→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   206→        return False
   207→    return abs(score_value - target_value) <= tolerance_value

   210→def register_scoring_policy(policy: DetectorScoringPolicy) -> None:
   211→    """Register a scoring policy at runtime (used by generic plugins)."""
   212→    DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES[policy.detector] = policy
   213→    _rebuild_derived()

   216→def _rebuild_derived() -> None:
   217→    """Rebuild DIMENSIONS, DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME, FILE_BASED_DETECTORS from current state.
   218→
   219→    Mutates existing objects in-place so that all references (including imports
   220→    that bound the original objects) see the updates.
   221→    """
   222→    new_dims = _build_dimensions()
   223→    DIMENSIONS.clear()
   224→    DIMENSIONS.extend(new_dims)
   225→    DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME.clear()
   226→    DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME.update({d.name: d for d in DIMENSIONS})
   227→    FILE_BASED_DETECTORS.clear()
   228→    FILE_BASED_DETECTORS.update(
   229→        det for det, pol in DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.items() if pol.file_based
   230→    )

   235→    return DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.get(

   332→def on_detector_registered(callback: Callable[[], None]) -> None:

   334→    _on_register_callbacks.append(callback)
   335→
   336→
   337→def register_detector(meta: DetectorMeta) -> None:
   338→    """Register a detector at runtime (used by generic plugins)."""
   339→    global JUDGMENT_DETECTORS
   340→    DETECTORS[meta.name] = meta
   341→    if meta.name not in _DISPLAY_ORDER:
   342→        _DISPLAY_ORDER.append(meta.name)
   343→    JUDGMENT_DETECTORS = frozenset(
   344→        name for name, m in DETECTORS.items() if m.needs_judgment
   345→    )
   346→    for cb in _on_register_callbacks:
   347→        cb()

   351→    """All registered detector names, sorted."""
   352→    return sorted(DETECTORS.keys())

   369→def dimension_action_type(dim_name: str) -> str:
   370→    """Return a compact action type label for a dimension based on its detectors."""
   371→    best = "manual"
   372→    best_pri = 99
   373→    for d in DETECTORS.values():
   374→        if d.dimension == dim_name:
   375→            pri = _ACTION_PRIORITY.get(d.action_type, 99)
   376→            if pri < best_pri:
   377→                best_pri = pri
   378→                best = d.action_type
   379→    return _ACTION_LABELS.get(best, "manual")

   394→        result[name] = entry

   178→    if status == "warn" and matched_keys:
   179→        matched_entries = subjective_entries_for_dimension_keys(
   180→            matched_keys, subjective_entries
   181→        )
   182→        return {
   183→            "status": "warn",
   184→            "count": len(matched_keys),
   185→            "target": target_display,
   186→            "entries": matched_entries,
   187→            "rendered": render_subjective_names(matched_entries),
   188→            "command": subjective_rerun_command(matched_entries, max_items=max_items),
   189→        }
   190→
   191→    at_target = sorted(
   192→        [
   193→            entry
   194→            for entry in subjective_entries
   195→            if not entry.get("placeholder")
   196→            and subjective_integrity_mod.matches_target_score(
   197→                float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0))),
   198→                threshold_value,
   199→            )
   200→        ],
   201→        key=lambda entry: str(entry.get("name", "")).lower(),
   202→    )
   203→    if not at_target:
   204→        return None
   205→
   206→    return {
   207→        "status": "at_target",
   208→        "count": len(at_target),
   209→        "target": threshold_value,
   210→        "entries": at_target,
   211→        "rendered": render_subjective_names(at_target),
   212→        "command": subjective_rerun_command(at_target, max_items=max_items),
   213→    }
   214→
   215→
   216→def subjective_integrity_notice_lines(
   217→    integrity_notice: dict[str, object] | None,
   218→    *,
   219→    fallback_target: float = 95.0,
   220→) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
   221→    if not integrity_notice:
   222→        return []
   223→
   224→    status = str(integrity_notice.get("status", "")).strip().lower()
   225→    count = coerce_notice_count(integrity_notice.get("count", 0))
   226→    target_display = coerce_target_score(
   227→        integrity_notice.get("target"),
   228→        fallback=fallback_target,
   229→    )
   230→    rendered = str(integrity_notice.get("rendered", "subjective dimensions"))
   231→    command = str(integrity_notice.get("command", ""))
   232→
   233→    if status == "penalized":
   234→        return [
   235→            (
   236→                "red",
   237→                "WARNING: "
   238→                f"{count} subjective dimensions matched target {target_display:.1f} "
   239→                f"and were reset to 0.0 this scan: {rendered}.",
   240→            ),
   241→            (
   242→                "yellow",
   243→                "Anti-gaming safeguard applied. Re-review objectively and import fresh assessments.",
   244→            ),
   245→            ("dim", f"Rerun now: {command}"),
   246→        ]
   247→
   248→    if status == "warn":
   249→        dimension_label = "dimension is" if count == 1 else "dimensions are"

    10→def print_score_update(
    11→    state: dict,
    12→    prev: state_mod.ScoreSnapshot,
    13→    *,
    14→    config: dict | None = None,
    15→    label: str = "Scores",
    16→) -> None:
    17→    """Print score quartet with deltas and strict target progress.
    18→
    19→    Args:
    20→        state: Current state dict (scores already recomputed by save_state).
    21→        prev: ScoreSnapshot taken before the operation.
    22→        config: Project config dict (loaded from disk if not provided).
    23→        label: Prefix label (default "Scores").
    24→    """
    25→    new = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
    26→    if (
    27→        new.overall is None
    28→        or new.objective is None
    29→        or new.strict is None
    30→        or new.verified is None
    31→    ):
    32→        print(colorize(f"\n  {label} unavailable — run `desloppify scan`.", "yellow"))

    34→
    35→    overall_s, overall_c = format_delta(new.overall, prev.overall)
    36→    objective_s, objective_c = format_delta(new.objective, prev.objective)
    37→    strict_s, strict_c = format_delta(new.strict, prev.strict)
    38→    verified_s, verified_c = format_delta(new.verified, prev.verified)
    39→
    40→    print(
    41→        f"\n  {label}: "
    42→        + colorize(f"overall {new.overall:.1f}/100{overall_s}", overall_c)
    43→        + colorize(f"  objective {new.objective:.1f}/100{objective_s}", objective_c)
    44→        + colorize(f"  strict {new.strict:.1f}/100{strict_s}", strict_c)
    45→        + colorize(f"  verified {new.verified:.1f}/100{verified_s}", verified_c)
    46→    )
    47→
    48→    # Always show strict target + next-command nudge
    49→    if config is None:
    50→        from desloppify.core import config as config_mod
    51→
    52→        config = config_mod.load_config()
    53→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score import target_strict_score_from_config
    54→
    55→    target = target_strict_score_from_config(config, fallback=95.0)
    56→    _print_strict_target_nudge(new.strict, target)

    58→
    59→def _print_strict_target_nudge(
    60→    strict: float, target: float, *, show_next: bool = True,
    61→) -> None:
    62→    """Print a one-liner with strict→target and optional next-command nudge."""
    63→    gap = round(target - strict, 1)

    66→        print(colorize(f"  Strict {strict:.1f} (target: {target:.1f}){suffix}", "dim"))
    67→    else:
    68→        print(colorize(f"  Strict {strict:.1f} — target {target:.1f} reached!", "green"))
    69→

    71→__all__ = ["print_score_update", "_print_strict_target_nudge"]

    21→    if not isinstance(scan_coverage, dict):

    23→    lang_name = getattr(lang, "name", None) if lang is not None else None
    24→    if isinstance(lang_name, str) and lang_name:
    25→        entry = scan_coverage.get(lang_name, {})
    26→        return entry if isinstance(entry, dict) else {}
    27→    return {}
    28→
    29→
    30→def _coverage_reduction_warnings(state: dict, lang) -> list[str]:

    37→    for detector, payload in detectors.items():

    53→        if remediation:

   161→def compute_health_breakdown(
   162→    dimension_scores: dict, *, score_key: str = "score"
   163→) -> dict[str, object]:
   164→    """Return pool averages and weighted contribution breakdown for score transparency."""
   165→    if not dimension_scores:
   166→        return {
   167→            "overall_score": 100.0,
   168→            "mechanical_fraction": 1.0,
   169→            "subjective_fraction": 0.0,
   170→            "mechanical_avg": 100.0,
   171→            "subjective_avg": None,
   172→            "entries": [],
   173→        }
   174→
   175→    mech_sum = 0.0
   176→    mech_weight = 0.0
   177→    subj_sum = 0.0
   178→    subj_weight = 0.0
   179→    mechanical_rows: list[dict[str, float | str]] = []
   180→    subjective_rows: list[dict[str, float | str]] = []
   181→
   182→    for name, data in dimension_scores.items():
   183→        score = float(data.get(score_key, data.get("score", 0.0)))
   184→        is_subjective = "subjective_assessment" in data.get("detectors", {})
   185→        if is_subjective:
   186→            configured = max(0.0, _subjective_dimension_weight(name, data))
   187→            effective = configured
   188→            subj_sum += score * effective
   189→            subj_weight += effective
   190→            subjective_rows.append(
   191→                {
   192→                    "name": str(name),
   193→                    "score": score,
   194→                    "configured_weight": configured,
   195→                    "effective_weight": effective,
   196→                }
   197→            )
   198→            continue
   199→
   200→        checks = float(data.get("checks", 0) or 0)
   201→        sample_factor = min(1.0, checks / MIN_SAMPLE) if checks > 0 else 0.0
   202→        configured = max(0.0, _mechanical_dimension_weight(name))
   203→        effective = configured * sample_factor
   204→        mech_sum += score * effective
   205→        mech_weight += effective
   206→        mechanical_rows.append(
   207→            {
   208→                "name": str(name),
   209→                "score": score,
   210→                "checks": checks,
   211→                "sample_factor": sample_factor,
   212→                "configured_weight": configured,
   213→                "effective_weight": effective,

   216→
   217→    mech_avg = (mech_sum / mech_weight) if mech_weight > 0 else 100.0
   218→    subj_avg = (subj_sum / subj_weight) if subj_weight > 0 else None

   230→        subjective_fraction = SUBJECTIVE_WEIGHT_FRACTION
   231→        overall_score = round(

   233→            1,
   234→        )
   235→

   237→

   249→                "checks": float(row["checks"]),
   250→                "sample_factor": float(row["sample_factor"]),
   251→                "configured_weight": float(row["configured_weight"]),
   252→                "effective_weight": float(row["effective_weight"]),
   253→                "pool_share": pool_share,

   134→def phase_structural(
   135→    path: Path, lang: LangRun
   136→) -> tuple[list[Finding], dict[str, int]]:
   137→    """Merge large + complexity + god classes into structural findings."""
   138→    structural: dict[str, dict] = {}
   139→
   140→    large_entries, file_count = large_detector_mod.detect_large_files(
   141→        path, file_finder=lang.file_finder, threshold=lang.large_threshold
   142→    )
   143→    for e in large_entries:

   145→            structural, e["file"], f"large ({e['loc']} LOC)", {"loc": e["loc"]}
   146→        )

   148→    complexity_entries, _ = complexity_detector_mod.detect_complexity(
   149→        path,
   150→        signals=PY_COMPLEXITY_SIGNALS,

   162→

   166→    for e in god_entries:
